title.zh: 微软股价触及近一年高点，公司宣布计划大规模部署自有人工智能芯片
title.en: 微软股价触及近一年高点，公司宣布计划大规模部署自有人工智能芯片

current_state.zh: Microsoft announced its third-generation Maia 300 AI accelerator, plans to progressively shift data-center AI workloads onto its own Maia architecture at gigawatt scale to reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs, with production targeted for 2027, as the stock touched a near one-year high.
